description: Render your current persistent Switch Editor project as an MP4 through the Switch render service. Use get_editor_run to follow it to playback and download; the finished render carries renderChecks (black gaps, blank screens, frozen stretches, missing layers, dropped sound, with seconds). Look at it with contact_sheet and frame_at, and never hand it over with open findings without saying so. timeline renders one timeline tab by name or id (that tab becomes the open one); default the open tab.

project_id.description: The Editor project id to render, from list_editor_projects.

timeline.description: Which timeline tab to render, by name ("30 s") or id (read_editor_timeline lists them). Default: the open tab.

name: render_editor_project
title: Render Editor Project
